data.question: Does exact-source Kefir protect a restored auxiliary recursor's rule-to-constructor ownership relation while accepting an unchanged nested export and an independent whole-block reorder?
data.versions: Kefir 0.1.0 exact-source native release build; rustc 1.99.0; lean4export input format 3.1.0
data.commands: python3 explorations/runs/EXPLORE-KEFIR-RECURSOR-TRANSFER-1/run-trial.py; the runner verifies frozen hashes, supplies each file through Kefir's IN contract, applies 30s/4GiB process limits, and retains JSON verdicts and receipts.
data.sample: Three fixed cells on one exact checker: unchanged control, valid whole-block reorder, and a one-record restored-rule constructor-association candidate.
data.controls: Both valid files must accept. The candidate changes only LALNest.rec_1 rules[0].ctor from LALWrap.mk to unrelated earlier LALMarker.mark. Attributed reject is coverage signal; decline is inconclusive; acceptance requires source evidence of safe reconstruction before any soundness interpretation.
